headline: Xbox prices are increasing by up to €200 or £170
summary: Microsoft is significantly raising Xbox console prices in the EU and UK. Increases could be as high as €200 or £170, depending on the model. The 1TB Xbox Series X with a disc drive is specifically mentioned as affected.

headline: Skylight’s smart calendars are up to $90 off during its back-to-school sale
summary: Skylight smart calendars are offering discounts of up to $90 during a back-to-school sale. The promotion runs from August 2nd through August 9th. These calendars help families manage busy schedules and responsibilities effectively.

headline: HP’s HyperX Omen 15 isn’t quite the budget-friendly gaming laptop its predecessor was
summary: The new HP HyperX Omen 15 replaces the formerly budget-friendly HP Victus 15 gaming laptop. While it features upgrades like an RTX 5050, it no longer maintains the low price point of its predecessor. The Victus 15 was known for being a good entry-level gaming option around $800.

headline: Is paying artists enough to convince them to embrace AI?
summary: Artists have raised concerns for years about generative AI models using their work without permission. The debate questions if financial compensation can resolve intellectual property disputes in AI development. Contentious legal battles continue as artists seek fair treatment regarding AI training data.

headline: Hideo Kojima Reviews Spider-Man: Brand New Day: 'It Felt Fresh, and I Really Enjoyed It'
summary: Hideo Kojima, the acclaimed game director, has reviewed 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day'. He praised the title, stating it 'felt fresh' and highlighted its take on a 'lonely Peter Parker'. Kojima concluded by expressing that he 'really enjoyed' the experience.

headline: What the Heck Is Marvel Doing With the Hulk Anyway!?
summary: Following 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day,' fans are questioning Marvel's current direction for The Hulk. The article delves into the character's recent narrative choices. It reflects on the ongoing developments for the iconic green giant.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Beats Avengers: Endgame Record to Claim Biggest Domestic Opening Day of All Time
summary: Marvel Studios' 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' has broken a significant box office record. It secured the biggest domestic opening day of all time, earning a whopping $168 million. This achievement surpasses the previous record held by 'Avengers: Endgame'.

headline: Game of Thrones: The Mad King Reveals Full Stage Cast and First Portrait
summary: The stage play 'Game of Thrones: The Mad King' has unveiled its complete cast list. A first official portrait features key characters, including King Aerys II and Rhaegar Targaryen. Young Ned Stark is also among the prominently featured cast members.

headline: Burnham pledges to be 'relentless' in curbing small boat crossings
summary: Prime Minister Burnham has vowed to be 'relentless' in efforts to curb small boat crossings. He emphasized the need for increased enforcement measures. Burnham also suggested the importance of establishing more safe routes into the UK.

headline: Man admits killing Scottish woman found in suitcase, Greek police say
summary: Greek police report a man has confessed to killing 38-year-old Elisabeth-Jane Ross, a Scottish woman. Her body was discovered in a suitcase in Greece. The man faces charges including murder, robbery, and weapons offences.

headline: Prolonged drought could cause shortage of some foods, farmers' union head says
summary: The head of the NFU, Tom Bradshaw, warned that a prolonged drought could lead to food shortages. He urged the government to take proactive measures. Bradshaw called for action to safeguard the UK's food supply from extreme weather impacts.

headline: Ukraine says major Russian oil refinery and airfield hit, as Moscow reports eight deaths
summary: Ukraine claims to have struck a significant Russian oil refinery and an airfield. Moscow, in turn, reported eight deaths resulting from overnight attacks. Russia's military confirmed it targeted Ukrainian ports and vessels in the Black Sea.
